title: A Speech at the Graduation
text:
Every year, the head teacher gives a speech at the graduation ceremony. The speech usually reviews the school year and thanks the teachers and parents. Students often feel nervous, because they know that many people will be listening. Some speakers share a short personal story to make their message more memorable.

Last year, a student named Anna gave a short speech that surprised everyone. She spoke about her difficult first month at school and how a teacher had helped her. Her classmates listened quietly, and many of them applauded at the end. Later, several parents said it was the best speech they had heard at the school.

questions.text: What do some speakers add to make their message more memorable?
What did Anna talk about in her speech?
options: Her difficult first month at school

questions.text: Why were Anna's classmates probably so quiet while she spoke?
options: They were listening carefully to her story
They were bored by the topic
They were waiting for the ceremony to end

questions.text: What can be inferred about the effect of Anna's speech?
options: It had a strong effect on the people who heard it
It was forgotten by everyone the next day
It was written by one of the parents
It was rejected by the head teacher

vocabulary.definition: a formal event held for a special occasion
worried or anxious about something that is about to happen
easy to remember because it is special or interesting
clapped hands to show approval or appreciation

paragraph_translations: Co roku dyrektor szkoły wygłasza przemówienie podczas ceremonii ukończenia szkoły. Mowa zwykle podsumowuje rok szkolny i dziękuje nauczycielom oraz rodzicom. Uczniowie często czują się zdenerwowani, ponieważ wiedzą, że wielu ludzi będzie ich słuchać. Niektórzy mówcy dzielą się krótką osobistą historią, aby ich przesłanie było bardziej pamiętne.

W zeszłym roku uczennica o imieniu Anna wygłosiła krótkie przemówienie, które zaskoczyło wszystkich. Opowiedziała o swoim trudnym pierwszym miesiącu w szkole i o tym, jak pomógł jej pewien nauczyciel. Jej koledzy słuchali w ciszy, a wielu z nich klaskało na koniec. Później kilku rodziców powiedziało, że było to najlepsze przemówienie, jakie słyszeli w tej szkole.
